title: Compact pathway annotations for Private Cluster console
creator: Maya Chen
description: Design and prototype a compact annotation layer for the Private Cluster console that surfaces critical network path properties (latency, egress cost signals, last-upgrade status) inline with cluster tiles and topology sparklines. The goal is to give operators an at-a-glance risk score and one-click drill paths for rollouts/rollback actions without leaving the cluster list view.
acceptance_criteria: Compact annotation strip appears on cluster list view and scales to 5 clusters per row at 1280px width
Hover or tap expands a contextual mini-panel with path summary, recent upgrade timeline, and an action menu (canary rollback, open runbook)
Annotation includes three primary signals: path-latency (3 buckets), egress-cost-alert (binary + estimate), and upgrade-stability (green/amber/red)
Prototype validated in a 5-person usability session with Platform Engineering and at least 80% task success for locating a rollback control
Design tokens and spacing follow the console design system; final spec includes CSS variables and accessibility (contrast/keyboard) notes
design_notes: 2025-02-14: kickoff with PM/Eng. Agreed scope: do not add new backend endpoints; annotate using existing telemetry (path-latency metric, billing egress estimate, upgrade_state flag).
2025-02-18: explored three visual metaphors (chip stack, horizontal strip, radial badge). Horizontal strip chosen for density and scanability.
Trade-offs: compact strip reduces surface area for custom metadata; decided to surface only highest-value signals to keep cognitive load low.

Implementation note for ENG: provide aggregated latency buckets (LOW/MED/HIGH), an egress-estimate string ("~$12/day"), and stability_score (0-100) endpoint; fallback to 'unknown' if telemetry absent.
Accessibility: ensured 4.5:1 contrast for amber/red states and keyboard focus reveals the mini-panel.
review_feedback: PM (Lena Patel) 2025-02-20: +1 on strip, asked to add explicit 'last-successful-upgrade' timestamp when available.
Eng (Arjun Gupta) 2025-02-22: raised concern about extra calls for stability_score; accepted aggregated endpoint suggestion, ENG to return synthetic 'unknown' to avoid noise.
Security (Priya Singh) 2025-02-25: callout to avoid embedding tenant identifiers in tooltip copy; approved wording changes in mockups.
Design lead (Omar Khalid) 2025-02-27: requested micro-animation for panel open/close, suggested 150ms ease for perceived responsiveness.
notes_for_engineering: Render strip in a single DOM node per cluster to minimize reflow during telemetry updates.
Use CSS transforms for the mini-panel animation; avoid layout thrash on open/close.
Batch telemetry updates at 5s frequency and debounce hover-triggered data fetches.
Fallbacks: if telemetry missing, show 'data unavailable' pill and provide link to troubleshooting runbook.
usability_test_plan: Recruit 5 platform engineers and 3 SREs familiar with Private clusters
Tasks: identify a cluster with high egress cost; open mini-panel and initiate a canary rollback
Success criteria: 80% complete tasks within 2 minutes without help
